technical_summary: Stratified tiered anomaly scan detected statistical deviations across multi-dimensional micro-segments where aggregate macro metrics remained within baseline tolerance.

layer_breakdown.L1: Domain integrity checks identified null-padding and orphaned foreign key joins during ETL promo attribution.
layer_breakdown.L2: Segment-level Z-score evaluation (|Z| > 3.0) isolated high-impact negative margin cells masked by overall revenue.
layer_breakdown.L3: Vector divergence spotted engagement click-volume spikes that failed to resolve into settled ledger revenue.
layer_breakdown.L4: Period structural analysis indicated steady margin erosion over rolling 30-day windows.

actionable_recommendations.title: ETL & Pipeline Fixes
actionable_recommendations.action: Audit ingestion scripts for missing foreign key constraints on campaign attribution tables.

actionable_recommendations.title: Dynamic Baseline Implementation
actionable_recommendations.action: Deploy rolling 30-day windowed Z-score models in dbt to replace static global thresholding.

actionable_recommendations.title: Ledger Reconciliation Automation
actionable_recommendations.action: Schedule automated micro-batch jobs comparing engagement event logs with transaction ledgers every 2 hours.
